wholeCurrentGoal.title: Genetische Neukombination und Biodiversität verknüpfen
wholeCurrentGoal.description: Die lernende Person kann den Zusammenhang zwischen genetischen Neukombinationsprozessen und der Evolution bisheriger sowie zukünftiger Biodiversität erklären.
wholeCurrentGoal.descriptionEn: The learner can explain the relationship between genetic recombination processes and the evolution of past and future biodiversity.

result.actualViewTool: Each actual file independently forwarded with view_image at original detail before prompts, reconstruction, caption/alt and author-inspection content.

scientificCorrectness.reason: The two replicated homologues each have two sister chromatids with the same two shown loci. In the new finite exchange panel all four chromatids remain separately countable; the inner nonsister pair exchanges distal segments reciprocally, with no confusing intersecting four-way chiasma. Upper-locus markers stay yellow/red-parent or purple/blue-parent; lower-locus markers yield green and yellow parental forms and yellow/green exchanged forms. Two unchanged and two recombinant marker combinations remain countable in the output. No new allele is generated. The single dotted arrow still points directly from these four products to four distinct species-like butterfly forms, without a population, inheritance across generations, selection or temporal cue. This does not assert an explicit instantaneous-speciation sentence, but it leaves the same material causal ambiguity for the complete biodiversity/evolution goal.

operativeGoalOrientation.reason: The finite reciprocal-exchange component helps explain reshuffling of existing variants. Evolution of biodiversity also needs a clear population/generation relationship; the current single butterfly link does not visibly establish it.

result.originalViewReason: Actual1672x941 original inspected. Separate chromatids and reciprocal distal red/blue exchange can be followed, and the final allele-marker outputs retain two parental/two recombinant combinations. Output chromosome shafts again use their main red/blue color rather than preserving the swapped tip coloring from the central exchange model; the meaningful result is the shown marker combination, not a literal fully origin-colored final DNA rendering. The direct broad-biodiversity butterfly link remains visible.

result.labelsAndForms: Existing alleles, maternal/paternal homologues, Crossover, unchanged parental combinations and new combinations correctly orient the finite marker model. Four separately drawn chromatids avoid a false chiasma crossing interpretation. The final Vielfalt label still does not specify variation within a population, inheritance across generations, selection, or the conditional evolution of biodiversity.
result.actorPerspective: External schematic chromosomes and butterflies; no apparatus, directional writing or acting person requires a perspective correction.

formatAndStyle.reason: Actual1672x941 PNG is near16:9. It fits the680px card limit proportionally without crop or height-cap exception. Friendly rounded chromosome models and butterfly illustration, navy outlines and soft background match the reviewed set and suit upper-secondary learning. No visible watermark, provider logo, technical goal ID, graphic harm or photorealistic clinical claim.

result.exactRemedy: Retain the now separate reciprocal nonsister-chromatid exchange and correct two parental/two recombinant marker combinations. Make the visible bridge phone-readable: immediate variation within one population, with a separately conditional contribution to biodiversity through inheritance and selection across generations, or clearly disconnect the broad biodiversity motif from direct crossover products. Enlarge/shorten maternal/paternal and parental/recombinant labels. Reinspect the actual successor at original/360/680 and its actual current caption/alt; a prompt-only explanation cannot close these visible issues.
result.deltaFromOwnPriorV2: Actual exchange geometry is now more directly represented by four separated chromatids with reciprocal distal swaps. Own earlier actualV2 bridge and phone issues are not closed by this geometry change. This is a single actual successor review, not a repeated9/23 review.
result.claimLimits: Finite schematic exchange of existing allele combinations only; no actual meiosis, learner performance, new alleles, inevitable adaptation or immediate species creation.
